title: ARABIC and DECIMAL inside the 812-case unswept structural sweep: on record, no count
upstream_status_verbatim: Structural mismatch on at least one probe, local outcome confirmed genuine (execution_status=ok)
status_plain: Run unswept-structural-sweep-001 put 812 cases against Excel and scored 580 exact typed bit matches, 116 structural mismatches (97 real across 46 surfaces, 19 generator-invalid), 108 harness-blocked, 3 numeric_drift_gt1ulp and 5 numeric_drift_1ulp. ARABIC and DECIMAL are both named in the run's Candidate Surfaces list, and ARABIC additionally has its own pre-fix witness row: =ARABIC({2;3}) published #VALUE! locally where Excel published a 2x1 array of #VALUE!. So a structural Excel comparison IS on record for both surfaces. What does not exist is a per-surface count: the 812/580 is a 46-surface group total with no split, and neither ARABIC nor DECIMAL is inside the named resolution set that carries the 46/47. "No structural comparison record" is false for these two; "a structural comparison is on record, no row count was extracted" is the honest state.
